text:
Maya Singh: dropping a quick thread for the compact routing editor pass. Goals: clearer priority ordering affordances, better inline validation, and less noisy preview updates. Figma: https://figma.com/file/compact-pass. Screenshots attached.

Derek Holt: first glance: ordering handles are fine visually but functionally confusing. users tried to drag the rule and accidentally clicked the more menu. Suggest moving handle to extreme left and make it full-height so it's easier to hit on mobile.

Ana Ruiz: +1 on left handle. Also the priority chips (1,2,3) don't communicate that they're reorderable. Can we apply a small chevron or reorder affordance on hover and show a tooltip "Drag to reorder"? Keep it lightweight.

Victor Chen: validation copy: "Invalid matcher" is ambiguous. Propose: "Matcher syntax error — expected: equals | contains | regex. Click for examples." Put that inline under the rule in a subtle red, and add a compact docs link icon.

Maya Singh: thoughts about showing validation as a persistent inline pill vs ephemeral toast? My read: inline persistent pill is better for discoverability while editing and during drag flows. To avoid layout shift, animate max-height and overlay the preview slightly if needed.

Derek Holt: agree inline, but let's reserve space so the list doesn't jump. Use transform animations instead of changing flow. Also show a small error indicator on the left so users can scan the list quickly.

Ana Ruiz: simulation preview: it's spamming users with recalculations on every tiny drag. Add a 200ms debounce and show a tiny recalculating spinner on the preview snapshot. Also persist the sample traffic set per user so toggling off/on keeps selection.

UXCheckBot: a11y scan: keyboard reorder not implemented. Recommendation: Space or Enter to pick up, Arrow Up/Down to move, Enter/Space to drop, Escape to cancel. Announce events via aria-live: "Picked up rule '{name}'", "Moved to position {n}". Ensure focus returns to the moved rule after drop.

Victor Chen: color/accessibility: legend amber fails contrast in light theme. Recommend #B45309 for amber and bump legend text to 600 weight. Also distinguish heatmap green from success green: use `--sim-green: #047857`.

Maya Singh: UX decision summary: 1) move handle to left extreme, full-row hit area, 2) add "Drag to reorder" hover affordance, 3) inline persistent validation pill under card with docs link and animated max-height, 4) reserve visual space + use transform animations to avoid jumping, 5) debounce sim recalcs to 200ms + show spinner, 6) persist sample traffic selection, 7) implement keyboard reorder + aria-live announcements, 8) update legend color tokens (Victor). I'll update the Figma and create tickets under routing-editor.

Derek Holt: I'll prototype the left-handle behavior and the hover tooltip.

Ana Ruiz: I'll write the microcopy for the validation pill and the hover tooltip. Draft: "Matcher syntax error. Click for examples and quick fixes." short.

Victor Chen: I'll open a tiny tokens PR with `--legend-amber: #B45309` and `--sim-green: #047857`, plus bold legend text.

UXCheckBot: accessibility checklist: add keyboard reorder, aria-live strings, ensure focus management after drop, and verify color contrast in both dark/light themes.

Maya Singh: target: next sprint. Please add your action items to the routing-editor epic and tag me. Thanks all :sparkles:
